scope: Installed wrapper and paired launcher/daemon deployment

behaviors.contract: Compare source-build fingerprints, not version numbers or timestamp order; a confirmed mismatch rebuilds both targets and validates the result before activation.
Compatible binaries and newer source alone do not invoke Cargo. Cached identity probes are invalidated when a binary changes.
A background repair has one deployment lock, a 15-minute build deadline and a 256-KiB build-output bound. Repeated shortcuts still open the existing GUI without stopping a working daemon.
Unknown identities and failed or incomplete builds cannot activate a replacement. Failed identical pairs have a five-minute retry cooldown; user application windows are never recovery targets.
Diagnostic and control invocations cannot repair or restart the deployment, and build-ID probes do not initialize runtime diagnostics.
